semantic_review: Improvement objectives and preserved qualities share an evaluation scope; faster output does not excuse lost evidence.
Request-level first divergence precedes model attribution; facts and causes remain separate.
One controlled change is compared on fixed inputs with favorable and unfavorable metrics retained.
Spec, plan and tasks connect behavior, responsibility and evidence instead of file counts.
Per-stage empty, failed, insufficient and unselected states remain distinct; regression scope follows impact and accepts different student implementations.
scope: N application passages and six adjacent sequences, source preservation and both current editions. No runtime, whole-course review or duration proof.
